verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax firm whose software-supported offerings (e.g., ySolutions transparency-register filings) make a client-facing AI-insights capability a fair question. The only AI mention is firm boilerplate about using 'AI-based systems' internally to deliver advice. That is an adjacent internal practice, not a user-facing feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside a product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The firm combines legal and tax expertise with legal tech, digital workflows and AI-based systems to provide efficient and scalable advice.
